title: Morning runbook & candidate queue — Ryan
content:
Quick notes to self — morning of 2026-03-22

TOPLINE: heavy interview day (7 slots). prioritize onschedule confirmations, two reschedules pending, follow up on take-home assessment for candidate A, and push offer docs for B if hiring manager approves. block 11:30–12:30 for debriefs.

MORNING CHECKLIST (time-blocked)
- 08:30 — inbox triage (emails + green/amber candidate flags)
- 08:50 — confirm panels: send quick DM to interviewers for any last-minute conflicts
- 09:10 — follow-ups: resume send / take-home reminders (see templates below)
- 10:00 — calendar audit: make sure meeting links + zoom passcodes visible
- 11:30–12:30 — interview debriefs (block on calendar)
- 13:30 — resume scheduling for next week (focus SDE and PM pipelines)
- 15:00 — candidate experience check: slow replies >24h, escalate to hiring lead
- 16:30 — wrap + update tracker + handoff notes to evening cover (Jordan)

HOT CANDIDATE QUEUE (action items)
1) Candidate: Priya Desai — Senior SWE
   - [ ] status: take-home submitted 03-20, need grader assignment
   - [ ] action: assign grader (Maya) — pinged in Slack @Maya at 08:55 (waiting)
   - note: prefers feedback by Thu EOD; timezone IST (UTC+5:30) — interviewer windows 09:00–12:00 PST ok

2) Candidate: Miguel Torres — Data Infra
   - [x] status: phone screen done 03-18
   - [ ] action: schedule onsight take-home review with hiring manager (Jordan)
   - conflict: hiring manager out Wed afternoon — propose Thu/Fri

3) Candidate: Chen Li — ML Infra
   - [ ] status: panel scheduled 2026-03-22 14:00 PT (Zoom link updated)
   - [ ] action: confirm panel attendance at 09:15 (slack DM to panel)
   - note: ESL candidate, recommend slower pacing + share rubric ahead

4) Candidate: Amara Okoye — Product Design (urgent)
   - [ ] status: offer verbally approved by hiring manager; comp needs final sign-off from Erika (Recruiting Lead)
   - [ ] action: prepare offer packet draft; attach equity calc + start-date options
   - template: see "offer-draft-template-people-ops" (Confluence)

SCHEDULING/OPS: QUICK REFS
- timezone conversions (today): 09:00 PT = 12:00 ET = 17:30 IST
- default buffer rule: 15m between candidate calls unless candidate requests otherwise
- last-minute cancel/reschedule: if <24h notice, offer 2 alternate times within 3 business days

TEMPLATES (copy & paste)
- Quick follow-up (take-home reminder):
  "Hi {{name}},

  Just checking in on the coding assignment we sent on {{date}}. If you need extra time or have questions, happy to accommodate — please let me know. Our target for feedback is {{target_date}}.

  Cheers,
  Ryan"

- Panel confirmation reminder:
  "Quick confirmation: you’re on the panel for {{candidate}} today at {{time}} PT (Zoom link attached). Please score against the rubric and add bullet notes to the debrief doc. Ping me if anything comes up.

  — Ryan"

NOTES TO SELF / FRAGMENTS
- double-check Zoom host account for 13:00 panel (sometimes link regeneration breaks).
- flag Priya's take-home for rubric item: system design + code test (weight 60/40).
- follow up on RECRUIT-421 (offer letters automation): have SRE review templates by Friday.
- ask Erika about updated comp bands after 11:00 sync.

OPEN QUESTIONS / BLOCKERS
- who owns post-offer relocation coordination? (I thought Ops, but doc says People Ops) — quick check with People Ops handbook.
- need clear SLA for grading take-homes (currently ambiguous, put into hiring-ops sync)

HANDOFF (end-of-day to Jordan)
- leave note in Slack #recruiting with candidate list + which items escalated
- attach this doc link and update tracker row for each candidate status

RANDOM SCRATCH (brain dump)
- consider a rotating 1-hour "office hours" block for candidates to ask clarifying q's about take-home — could reduce extend requests
- experiment: two email templates for follow-up (casual vs formal) and A/B which gets faster replies

End of morning runbook. Keep this lightweight — update in place throughout the day.

-- Ryan
